description: This file defines the PdfArray class, representing a PDF array object within the PDFsharp library. It includes methods for cloning, enumeration, element access, and conversion utility functions for accessing elements as various types, as well as managing internal array elements.

classes.name: PdfArray
classes.description: Represents a PDF array object with capabilities for cloning, enumeration, and element access within the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: PdfArray.ArrayElements
classes.description: A nested class managing the collection of items within a PdfArray, supporting list operations, type conversions, and ownership management.

methods.name: PdfArray.Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the PdfArray, copying all elements.

methods.name: PdfArray.ToString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the array's contents.

methods.name: PdfArray.WriteObject
methods.description: Serializes the PdfArray object using the provided PdfWriter.
